scope: Local controlled chest UI; unchanged world/house/store/live/save source. No natural-world, all-overlay, animation, performance or physical-phone acceptance.

review.reconciled: Source-confirmed co-panel priority and hidden Vault feedback reproduced by actual Settings input and fixed by shared temporary visibility. Final five-panel real-input routing + six pure state regressions. Populated lists/native scroll/multiline and status HUD row now checked.

limits: Chest intentionally overlays mini-map where space is narrow; Close restores normal map interaction.
Scrollable item rows clip and existing hover tooltips may cover rows, not fixed heading/status/Close. Some two-column item names truncate; narrow <380px stacks columns.
Pets overlay priority is unit-state covered, not actual Pets-entry browser acceptance.
No automatic duplicate-save repair or publication.
